items.level_reason: Same kind of rule question as the official KNM fact items (who may refuse); key now parallel with both distractors.

evidence.quote: of als u te ver weg woont
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid, opened 2026-11-22: 'De huisarts die u kiest mag u weigeren als nieuwe patiënt wanneer: u te ver weg woont; de huisartsenpraktijk vol is; ...'. Distractors: no work and coming from another country are not on the list of grounds, and refusing for origin would be discrimination, so both are false. The prompt asks 'Wanneer', which sets up the condition. Different from 006 huisartskeuze (free choice) and 033 beroepsgeheim. Card 22 words, prompt 12.

meaning.situation_summary: Bo is searching for a new huisarts from his living-room table with a laptop and a notebook; the question asks in which case a huisarts may turn him down.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A person new in a town learns the two real grounds on which a GP may refuse a new patient and that his work or origin is no ground.
meaning.contrivance_check: Looking for a GP on a laptop at home is ordinary. The picture shows only the search, not a refusal, and the prompt itself asks for the condition so no exception is hidden.

items.level_reason: A plain detail question on a page statement; 'recept' and 'medicijnen' are everyday words at A2.

evidence.quote: Ook kijkt de apotheek of u andere medicijnen gebruikt
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid, opened 2026-11-22: 'De apotheek rekent kosten voor: de controle of op het recept de juiste sterkte en hoeveelheid ... staat; de controle of u andere medicijnen gebruikt die de werking van het medicijn kunnen veranderen; ...'. Distractors: a verwijsbrief belongs to specialist care and the pharmacy checks a recept instead; the pharmacy does not look at a bank balance. Different from 006 receptmedicijnen (where to get it) and 109 drogist. Card 22 words, prompt 12.

meaning.situation_summary: Yasmina stands at a pharmacy counter and the pharmacist hands her a small paper bag; the question asks what the pharmacy checks besides the recept.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A patient learns that the pharmacy also checks whether her other medicines interact with the new one, which is why she should mention them.
meaning.contrivance_check: Collecting medicine at a counter is ordinary and the paper bag does not show any check. The prompt now names the recept, which the card states first, so the word 'naast' has a referent.

items.level_reason: Time-fact question like the official KNM items on public services; the options no longer form a week/month/year scale.

evidence.quote: nodigt u uit als uw baby één maand is
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid, opened 2026-11-22: 'Het consultatiebureau nodigt u uit als uw baby 1 maand is.' and '(gratis jeugdgezondheidszorg)'. Distractors: a one-day-old baby is in kraamzorg and is not invited yet; a child who goes to school is past the 0-4 range of the consultatiebureau. The earlier 'een week' and 'een jaar' options were not clearly false because the consultatiebureau also sees babies at later ages. Different from 006 consultatiebureau (what it does) and 033 kraamzorg. Card 22 words, prompt 11.

meaning.situation_summary: Valerie sits on her sofa with a sleeping newborn in a blanket; the question asks when the consultatiebureau invites her.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A new mother learns when the first invitation of the jeugdgezondheidszorg arrives, so she can expect it.
meaning.contrivance_check: A mother with a baby asking about the first visit is ordinary. The picture shows a sleeping baby and no age, so it does not give the key away.

items.level_reason: Same rule family as the existing 006 verwijsbrief item, with a different tested fact; B and C are both hospital specialists, which is acceptable because both are plainly false.

evidence.quote: Naar een fysiotherapeut kunt u meestal zonder verwijsbrief.
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid, opened 2026-11-22: 'U kunt meestal zonder verwijzing naar een: fysiotherapeut; oefentherapeut; mondhygiënist; ...' and 'Voor specialistische zorg, bijvoorbeeld in ziekenhuizen, heeft u een verwijsbrief nodig.' 'Meestal' in prompt and key follows the exception for policies that require a referral. Distractors: a specialist and a chirurg in the hospital both need a verwijsbrief. Card 22 words, prompt 13.

meaning.situation_summary: Zakaria sits on a chair with a hand on his lower back; the question asks to whom he can go without a verwijsbrief.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A person with back pain learns that a physiotherapist is reachable directly while hospital specialists need a letter from the huisarts.
meaning.contrivance_check: Back pain and a cushion on a chair are ordinary and give no care provider away. 'Meestal' in the prompt matches the source's exception, so no hidden condition exists.

items.level_reason: Comparable with the official KNM items on zorgverzekering; options are now parallel 'Bij de ...' phrases.

evidence.quote: Bij de huisartsenpost betaalt u dat niet. Bij de spoedeisende hulp wel.
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid, opened 2026-11-22: 'Huisartsenzorg wordt volledig vergoed. De zorg gaat niet ten koste van uw verplichte eigen risico. Dat geldt ook voor de zorg op een huisartsenpost.' and 'Voor deze zorg [spoedeisende hulppost, in een ziekenhuis] geldt wel het verplichte eigen risico.' The same page says that from 1 January 2027 the bill of the spoedeisende hulp is split in two parts (the visit and the care), and that you never pay more than the remaining eigen risico; the rule that eigen risico applies there and not at the huisartsenpost is unchanged, so the card and key stay true after the change. Re-check yearly. Distractors: huisarts and huisartsenpost carry no eigen risico. Card 24 words, prompt 12.

meaning.situation_summary: Arjan sits on a sofa in the evening with a phone and a blanket; the question asks for which care he pays eigen risico.
meaning.communicative_purpose: An insured adult learns that the huisartsenpost is outside the eigen risico but a visit to the spoedeisende hulp falls inside it.
meaning.contrivance_check: An evening on the sofa with a phone fits a call to the huisartsenpost and hints at that distractor, not at the key. The prompt says 'heeft een zorgverzekering' so the eigen risico is set up without invented events.

items.level_reason: A one-fact question with a clear persona; easier than the official items because the number 112 is widely known, but the distractors are real numbers.

evidence.quote: Het alarmnummer 112 werkt in alle landen van de Europese Unie.
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid, opened 2026-11-22: 'U kunt het alarmnummer 112 bellen in alle landen van de Europese Unie (EU) en in een aantal andere landen.' and 'U mag het internationale alarmnummer 112 alleen bellen wanneer elke seconde telt.' Distractors, false for Spain: 0900-8844 is the Dutch number for the police when there is no emergency (Rijksoverheid, 'Wanneer kan ik alarmnummer 112 bellen?', confirmed via search 2026-11-22), and 999 is the emergency number of the United Kingdom, not of Spain. Spain is an EU member state. Different from 003 noodnummer (which situations) and 019 alarmnummer (no credit). Card 23 words, prompt 17.

meaning.situation_summary: Demi stands on a sunny street with a palm tree and a café, phone in hand, after seeing a serious accident in Spain; the question asks which alarm number works there.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A holidaymaker learns that the Dutch alarm number 112 is also the number to call anywhere in the EU, and that it is for moments when every second counts.
meaning.contrivance_check: A holiday abroad and a witnessed accident are a believable trigger for the question, and the sun and palm tree show a holiday setting without a number. The card's second sentence matches the 'ernstig ongeluk' in the prompt.

items.level_reason: A condition-based rule question like the official KNM items on zorgverzekering; the condition is in the prompt.

evidence.quote: Dan betaalt u de rekening eerst zelf.
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid, opened 2026-11-22: 'Heeft uw zorgverzekeraar geen contract met uw apotheek? Dan betaalt u eerst zelf de rekening. Daarna vraagt u de kosten bij uw zorgverzekeraar terug.' The prompt states the no-contract condition, so the zorgverzekeraar distractor is false in this case. The huisarts never pays a pharmacy bill. Same page as apotheek-controle but a different section and fact; 109 huisarts-rekening is about the huisarts bill. Card 24 words, prompt 18.

meaning.situation_summary: Valerie sits at a kitchen table with a small pharmacy bag and a paper receipt in front of her and studies the receipt; the question asks who pays the pharmacy bill first when there is no contract.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A patient learns she must pay the pharmacy herself first and then claim the money back from her insurer.
meaning.contrivance_check: A receipt and a bag at a kitchen table fit having paid at the counter. The picture shows neither who pays nor the contract, and the no-contract condition is written in the prompt rather than invented.

items.level_reason: A rights fact on a government page, comparable with official KNM items on patient rights; no numbers to remember.

evidence.quote: U heeft het recht om te weten wie er in uw dossier heeft gekeken.
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid 'Mag ik mijn medisch dossier inzien?', opened 2026-11-22: 'U kunt uw medisch dossier (online) inzien. U kunt ook een kopie krijgen. Ook heeft u het recht om te weten wie er in uw dossier heeft gekeken (logging).' and 'U krijgt alleen de gegevens te zien die over uzelf gaan.' Distractors: ziektes of other patients fall under the privacy of others, and the income of a huisarts is not part of a patient's dossier. The first card sentence ties the item to 4.4.3 (digital administration). Not the term (one month) the author tested: that is not in the eindterm paraphrase. Card 22 words, prompt 11.

meaning.situation_summary: Bo sits on a sofa with a tablet and looks at his own medical data online; the question asks what he may also find out.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A patient learns that online access to his dossier comes with the right to know who has looked at it.
meaning.contrivance_check: Checking one's own health data on a tablet at home is ordinary. The prompt says 'ook', which links to the card's first sentence, and the picture shows a tablet but no names or screen content.

items.level_reason: A condition-based yes/how-often question with the condition in the prompt; comparable with official items on toeslagen, and the one-time application is a known stumbling block.

evidence.quote: U hoeft dit maar één keer te doen.
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid, opened 2026-11-22: 'U kunt zorgtoeslag online aanvragen met Mijn toeslagen. Hiervoor heeft u DigiD nodig. U hoeft zorgtoeslag maar 1 keer aan te vragen. Daarna krijgt u de zorgtoeslag ieder jaar vanzelf. U moet wel aan de voorwaarden blijven voldoen.' Re-check yearly (toeslagen reform). The prompt sets the condition that Demi keeps meeting the conditions, so 'Elk jaar opnieuw' and 'Elke maand' are false. Different from 019 zorgtoeslag (DigiD to log in) and 109 servicepunt. Card 30 words, prompt 14.

meaning.situation_summary: Demi sits at a small desk with a laptop and a cup of tea in her living room; the question asks how often she has to apply for zorgtoeslag if she keeps meeting the conditions.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A person who needs help paying the health insurance learns that one application is enough and that the allowance then continues yearly.
meaning.contrivance_check: Applying online at a desk is ordinary, and the picture does not hint at once or yearly. The condition about the voorwaarden is in the prompt, so the claim is not misleading.

items.level_reason: A term-matching question whose persona nearly repeats the definition; easier than a comparable official definition item, which is acceptable for a term learners need to meet.

evidence.quote: Mantelzorg is zorg voor iemand die u kent, bijvoorbeeld een familielid, vriend of buur. U doet dat vrijwillig.
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid, opened 2026-11-22: 'U geeft mantelzorg als u voor iemand zorgt in uw omgeving. U doet dat vrijwillig, omdat u een sociale relatie met die persoon heeft.' and 'Een volwassene die zorgt voor een familielid, vriend of buur.' Second page: 'De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor de ondersteuning van mantelzorgers.' Distractors: thuiszorg is care by paid professionals; hulp van de gemeente is support for the mantelzorger, not the name of the care Arjan gives. The key is not 'de gemeente' as in 006 wmo and 109 schuldhulp. Mapping to 4.5.1 is loose and rests on the third card sentence. Card 23 words, prompt 20.

meaning.situation_summary: Arjan stands at an open front door with a pot of soup while an elderly neighbour smiles at him; the question describes his daily care for a sick neighbour and asks what it is called.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A resident learns the Dutch word for unpaid care for someone you know and that the gemeente can support people who do this.
meaning.contrivance_check: Bringing soup to a sick neighbour is ordinary and fits 'elke dag zorgen' without any extra event. The question gives the defining features, and the picture shows no word, so it does not print the key.

items.level_reason: A one-fact function question, easier than an official KNM item because two distractors are plainly outside what a meter does; options now share 'automatisch'.

evidence.quote: Een slimme meter geeft uw meterstanden automatisch door aan de netbeheerder.
evidence.summary: ACM ConsuWijzer, opened 2026-11-22: 'De slimme meter geeft uw meterstanden automatisch door aan uw netbeheerder.' The page also says the netbeheerder passes the readings to the energieleverancier. Distractors: the meter does not choose a supplier and does not pay the bill. 'Hoeveel energie Cas gebruikt' paraphrases 'meterstanden' (the numbers for stroom and gas on the meter). Different from 006 stroomstoring and 108 meterstanden. Card 22 words, prompt 13.

meaning.situation_summary: Cas stands in a hallway next to a small grey box on the wall with his hands in his pockets; the question asks what the smart meter for stroom and gas does.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A tenant or owner learns that the smart meter sends the readings to the netbeheerder by itself, so no manual reading is needed.
meaning.contrivance_check: A meter box in a hallway is ordinary and the picture shows no display or number. The prompt gives stroom and gas, matching the card, and the options all use 'automatisch' so the key is not signalled by one word.

items.level_reason: Comparable with official KNM items about contracts; the condition (before the end date) is in the prompt and the three options differ only in the kind of contract.

evidence.quote: Zegt u eerder op? Dan mag de leverancier geld vragen, een opzegvergoeding.
evidence.summary: ACM ConsuWijzer, opened 2026-11-22: 'Uw vaste tarief geldt voor bepaalde tijd: bijvoorbeeld 1 of 3 jaar. Zegt u vóór de einddatum op? Dan mag uw energieleverancier een opzegvergoeding vragen.'; variabel: 'Zegt u uw contract op? Dan betaalt u geen opzegvergoeding.'; 'Bij contracten met variabele en dynamische tarieven betaalt u geen opzegvergoeding.' The dynamic contract is described plainly as 'een prijs per uur'. Re-check yearly (energy contract rules). Different from 006 energietarief (what vast means) and 108 voorschot. Card 28 words, prompt 18.

meaning.situation_summary: Zakaria sits at a living-room table with a laptop and a blank sheet of paper and looks at the screen; the question asks for which contract type a supplier may charge a fee when he cancels before the end date.
meaning.communicative_purpose: A customer learns that cancelling a fixed-tariff energy contract early can cost an opzegvergoeding, unlike variable or per-hour contracts.
meaning.contrivance_check: Comparing or cancelling an energy contract at a laptop with a letter is ordinary. The early-cancellation condition is stated in the prompt, so the keyed fact is not hidden in an exception.

media_notes: Pictures: calm everyday settings, no text, no screen content, no visible answer. Bo appears in two briefs with identical traits; the dossier brief now shows him on a sofa with a tablet so the two pictures differ. The apotheek and kitchen-table scenes (Yasmina, Valerie) differ. alarmnummer-europa shows a holiday street (palm tree, café) and must not draw a sign or a number. slimme-meter shows a plain grey box without a display; dossier-logging shows a tablet with no readable text. Audio is generated later for the question and each option with --keys after integration. Re-check yearly: hap-eigen-risico (the spoedeisende hulp bill is split from 1 January 2027; the rule is unchanged), zorgtoeslag-eenmalig (toeslagen reform), opzegvergoeding-vast (energy contract rules).
limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.
Facts were read on the pages of 2026-11-22 only; the yearly re-check applies to eigen risico, zorgtoeslag and energy contract rules.
Mapping of mantelzorger-wie to eindterm 4.5.1 rests on the card's third sentence; the coordinator may re-tag if a stricter mapping is wanted.
The statement that 999 is not an emergency number in Spain was not verified on a Spanish government page; it follows the Rijksoverheid statement that 112 is the number across the EU.
